text:
kai: quick note  ran int4 PTQ for reranker-XL on holdout A (bench-mix-v3). overall NDCG@10 -2.9% vs fp16, but skewed: embed-similar pools show larger drop.

sophia: embed-similar meaning candidate pool has top1 candidate semantically very close? could be tiny logit perturbations flipping ties.

ram: also check embedding normalization upstream. We normalize vectors in prod but the bench harness accidentally skipped l2 norm during candidate pruning last week. That could change distribution fed to reranker.

kai: oh that's likely. bench pruning used raw dot scores; prod uses l2-normalized cosine. I'll re-run with prod-normed candidates and fixed candidate order.

ci-bot: CI: rerank-eval/4198765432 queued by kai  tag=reranker-XL-int4, dataset=bench-mix-v3/prod-norm, config="fixed-order" ETA ~12m

sophia: also add a calset that mixes embed-near pairs. PTQ calset should include adversarial ties so scales capture small delta behavior.

ram: good call. add per-channel quant + post-rescale sweep (0.96, 0.99, 1.02) to see if a tiny rescale recovers ordering.

kai: queued three quick jobs: fp16 baseline, int4-perchannel w/ mixed-calset + rescale=0.99, int4-perchannel + rescale=1.02.

ci-bot: CI: job 4198765432-1 finished  fp16 baseline NDCG@10=0.447
ci-bot: CI: job 4198765432-2 finished  int4-perchannel+calset-mixed+rescale0.99 NDCG@10=0.439 (-1.8% vs fp16)
ci-bot: CI: job 4198765432-3 finished  int4-perchannel+rescale1.02 NDCG@10=0.442 (-1.1% vs fp16)

sophia: rescale=1.02 recovered most of it. For embed-similar pools small multiplicative bias helps preserve rank ordering. We should standardize mixed-calset + per-channel + tiny rescale for rerankers.

ram: agree. Also update bench to enforce upstream embedding normalization parity; that reduced the gap by ~0.6% on a quick repro.

kai: plan: (1) default int4 PTQ config -> per-channel + mixed-calset + post-rescale=1.02 for rerankers, (2) add an "embed-similar" slice to quant holdout, (3) fix bench pruning to use l2-normalized vectors. I'll open PRs.

sophia: please include 12 failure pairs (pre/post) and a short note on why rescale helps in model-card PR.

eval-bot: Eval: rerank-eval/4198765432 jobs archived.

kai: thanks team. I'll post diffs and the PR links here.
